decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Design and access statement, P-236SR-01, P-236SR-02, P-236SR-03, P-236SR-05, fire statement 
Received: 15 July 2025
P-236SR-04 REV A
Received: 28/08/2025
HMO management statement REV A, parking stress survey 
Received: 24/09/2025].

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.
Condition : 4 - The house in multiple occupation hereby approved shall not be occupied by more than eight persons at any one time. 
 
Reason: In order to secure acceptable living conditions for occupiers, in the interests of the living conditions of neighbouring residents and parking conditions in the area and to comply with the terms of the application.
Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the submitted details and prior to occupation, full details (including manufacturer's specifications for no less than eight cycle spaces) of all cycle stands for the occupants of the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

The approved facilities shall be fully implemented and made available for use before any part of the development is first occupied and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.
description: Conversion of the existing single family dwelling (Use Class C3) into an eight person House in Multiple Occupation (Sui Generis) with associated parking, cycle parking and amenity space
